title: add RAG agent templates + tool-calling quickstarts and docs site updates
author: Priya Natarajan
description: Motivation: provide portable RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts so developers can onboard faster and experiment safely. This PR adds opinionated templates for RAG agents (retrieval configuration, prompt templates, eval seed prompts), new tool-calling examples (calendar, search, run-query), and docs site pages + quickstart notebooks. The description below is a single continuous string that outlines changes, checklist, and rollout notes. Changes include: (1) new templates under redwood-examples/agents/rag-templates; (2) tool-calling samples under redwood-examples/agents/tooling; (3) docs pages under redwood-docs/docs/agents/quickstarts; (4) updated sidebar and metadata for the docs site; (5) small SDK example updates in redwood-sdk-python to support a helper constructor used by the templates. Checklist: - [x] Add RAG templates and seed prompts - [x] Add tool-calling example handlers and README - [x] Add quickstart docs with code snippets and config examples - [x] Add integration tests for example notebooks (CI stage) - [x] Docs site build and local preview passes Notes: kept templates intentionally small and well-commented; examples use mock connectors and a production note explaining KMS & auth considerations. Rollout: merge to main, automatic docs deploy will publish under /agents/quickstarts. If any regressions in docs build or examples, revert via revert-63050. Related: ENG-1987 tracks quality gates and canary rollout for examples in the examples catalog.
